title: Address coordinates under decomposition
statement: For every natural number $m$, every sign vector $x$ of length $m+2^m$, and every address index $i<m$, the $i$th coordinate of the address part in the decomposition of $x$ equals the coordinate of $x$ at address position $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $m+2^m$
